Great restaurant for authentic South Indian food
May 2026 • Family
Here’s a polished version suitable for a Google review:

> This is truly a hidden gem for South Indian food in Hanoi. Every South Indian dish they serve is of exceptional quality and authentic taste — in some cases, even better than what we get back home in India.

The pongal and vada are standout dishes and absolutely worth trying. The variety of dosas, served with delicious chutneys and sambar, are equally excellent. We also thoroughly enjoyed the South Indian meals and the mini tiffin.

Mr. Rubin and his team provide warm and attentive customer service, which makes the overall dining experience even better.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic and high-quality South Indian food in Hanoi.

Delicious South Indian Veg Food
Feb 2026 • Family
visited on 4th Feb 26, table3 floor1.
Ambiance: nice in general.
Service: totally underwhelming due to the following aspects:
No one to usher us in( though no other customer is present)
Table is not ready with the cutlery, tissues etc.,
Wait staff is inattentive, no proactive approach to reach out & take the order
No in between inquiring on the quality of the food or if anything else can be ordered
No attention to prompt clearing up of the table and cleaning of the floor near by that is strewn with some leftover food items for long
Approach of the wait staff( one young girl) is just offish. Need to even prompt her to get the bill etc., Very laid back inattentive functional service.
Atleast, the gentleman at the Cash Counter could have engaged with the customers regularly to ascertain the quality of food, overall experience etc. But he is preoccupied on his mobile.

Food: we ordered 2 Tiffin Thalis for 356400vnd. Food is delicious though, thankfully.
Washroom can have much better toiletries and wet surface need to be mopped regularly.

Both the cleanliness and service levels need thorough improvement.

Authentic
Mar 2025 • Friends
Southern Delights Hanoi continues to impress, compelling me to return in a remarkably short span of just three weeks, marking my fourth visit. My previous review highlighted the consistency of their offerings, which has undoubtedly improved. The culinary experience has been refined to a level where each meal now stands as a testament to their dedication to quality and authenticity. As a South Indian myself, I can unequivocally vouch for the genuineness of the flavors, which capture the essence of traditional Southern cuisine with remarkable accuracy. The attention to detail in both the preparation and presentation is evident, ensuring a delightful experience with every visit. I look forward to returning again soon, confident that Southern Delights Hanoi will consistently deliver on its promise of excellent food and authentic flavors.

Between 10th September to 13th October 2024
visited this Spot four times, each time with different expatriate friends who are quite fond of south indian vegetarian dishes. The decor is simple and seating is comfortable. 

Hanoi has sparse south indian food options, that too authentic ones. The food here is authentic but the reason why 1-star is taken away is because of the consistency factor, both in terms of food and service. On any given day, it can be a top hit or a sad miss. If the Management applies little more effort on these factors, this would be a place for full value for your money.

🇵🇸Magnificent Indian cuisine from the country’s south!🇵🇸
Jun 2024 • Solo
Excellent southern Indian vegetarian fare and all the dishes are indicated for various lifestyles - vegan, gluten free and spicy. This is a vegan and vegetarian restaurant in Hanoi’s centre. The decor is classy and prices reflect this, and are fair for non-standard cuisine in Vietnam. If you don’t want water, make this clear; otherwise you’ll be charged for this - a small bottle of water setting you back for a 1.5 litre bottle in a convenience store. Pretty exorbitant really! The food itself is perfectly spiced and various items come with some mellowing raita. WiFi’s great, seats are padded, and service welcoming.
